competitorWins: DeepStateMap is genuinely stronger for Ukraine-war tracking: unmatched granularity with color-coded territory zones (including recently liberated areas), unit and headquarters markers, artillery range overlays for specific systems, and a news feed tied to map locations. Cited by the BBC and Ukrainska Pravda and averaging ~900,000 daily views, it is the definitive public frontline map — depth WorldEye does not attempt.
description: DeepStateMap.Live is an open-source-intelligence interactive map of the Russo-Ukrainian war, created on 24 February 2022 by the volunteer-led NGO Deep State UA. It shows color-coded territory control, unit/airfield/fleet positions, attack directions, a news feed, distance measurement, NASA FIRMS fire-point overlays, and artillery range overlays (HIMARS, M777, CAESAR). It differs from WorldEye by being a single-conflict, volunteer-run map — free with no signup and no paid tier — while WorldEye is a freemium global live-planet platform where conflict monitoring is one Pro intel feed among many.

seoDescription: WorldEye vs DeepStateMap: free global 3D globe with cameras, flights and Pro OSINT vs the definitive free public map of the Ukraine war frontline.
seoTitle: WorldEye vs DeepStateMap (2026): Free Live Globe or Ukraine War Map?
tagline: Volunteer-run interactive map tracking the frontline of the Russo-Ukrainian war in near real time.
verdictCompetitor: Choose DeepStateMap if you want the most detailed free public map of the Russo-Ukrainian war's frontline — and it's completely free.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, no-signup global live globe — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — with conflict intel and Pro OSINT tools for any region on Earth.
whyWorldEye: DeepStateMap covers one war; WorldEye's free globe covers the whole planet — ~76,000 live cameras, live flights, ships, satellites, weather, earthquakes, and wildfires with no signup.
WorldEye shows multiple concurrent conflicts and crises through its Pro premium intel feeds (cyber, GDELT, maritime, conflict, live news) — not just Ukraine.
Pro starts at $3.99/week: AI analyst assistant, OSINT recon toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), high-res satellite imagery, global search and advanced filters.
Free live aircraft and maritime vessel tracking that DeepStateMap does not provide.
Interactive 3D globe and a mobile-friendly experience for exploring any region, not a single frontline.
Use them together: DeepStateMap for Ukraine frontline detail, WorldEye for everything else happening on the planet.
